analysis.inspected_by: agent (GitHub Copilot, session A) using the reference-analyst workflow
analysis.method: Viewed overview (40 frames), transitions sheet (all 4 boundaries, every 2nd frame), listen sheet (12 accent hits; no phrases), strips 7.0-7.8 s and 20.45-20.85 s at 30 fps and 21.3-22.2 s at 15 fps; automated audio and listen metrics. Signal features and Windows desktop dictation only (no whisper or Parakeet on this host, earshot models not cached); nothing was listened to by a person.
analysis.coverage: Full 30 s; every boundary and the theme switch at frame level.

concept.observed: Launch film for a markdown editor: a heading typed as raw markup that re-sets as a serif headline, formatting chips float in, the words scatter and implode into a point that bursts into the logo, then a feature tour (live preview, local storage, linting, a dark theme, export, themes, price) and a logo end card.
concept.interpreted: The product's own act (raw text becoming formatted) is the opening image.

communication_style.observed: Two-line headlines: a black serif word over an italic terracotta phrase; no voice.

palette.observed: Cream canvas with a warm vignette, terracotta accent; a near-black section 22.0-26.3 s.

typography.observed: Serif display in roman with an italic accent line; monospace for typed raw text; small UI text.

composition.observed: Centred headline in the first act; feature cards with the headline left and UI right.

motion.observed: Monospace typing with a caret, then the word re-sets in the serif (0.4-1.9 s); chips drift; letters scatter and rotate (6.4 s); windows tilt in 3D; icon cards pop; the theme icon morphs from sun to moon (21.83-22.17 s).

transitions.observed: 7.00-7.67 s: dashed rays converge on a terracotta point while the page dims (7.30-7.47 s), a bright frame, then a ring shockwave expands for about 0.27 s while the icon assembles from scattered characters. 20.52-20.75 s: a terracotta diagonal band with stepped lighter edges sweeps left to right, full cover at 20.62 s, about 0.23 s in all. 21.83-22.03 s: after a click on the theme toggle a dark circle grows from the toggle to fill the frame. 22.48-22.60 s: a grey exposure dip between two dark scenes. 26.09-26.43 s: particles converge to a point on dark, a grey frame, then the cream ring burst and the logo again.
transitions.interpreted: Collapse-and-release for the brand moments; a band wipe for a section change; the product's own control causes the dark-mode transition.

timing_and_rhythm.observed: A feature every 0.93-1.9 s from 15 to 26 s.

sound_design.observed: -14.1 LUFS, LRA 8.2 LU, true peak -0.9 dBTP; tempo estimate 129.2 bpm (medium); 24 accents (48/min). Accents at 0.07, 0.39, 0.77 and 2.04 s coincide with typed characters, 4.04 and 4.50 s with chips landing, 7.55 s with the first ring frame of the burst, 8.96 s with the tagline and 12.72 s with a drawn line; 15.53-21.15 s they fall every 0.93 s (two beats at 129 bpm) with feature arrivals. 25% of 4 boundaries carry an accent within 100 ms (chance 15%); all 4 boundaries are within 50 ms of an onset (chance 33%) and 75% near the beat (chance 26%). Head and tail 7.8-7.9 dB below the body; 0.3 s of silence at the end. Accents may be part of the music.
sound_design.interpreted: Typing is sonified per character; the burst hit lands on the first frame of the ring.

narration.observed: None: dictation returned 18 raw words, none above confidence 0.2.

motifs.observed: Markup symbols as particles; rings; the file icon.

scenes.observed: Raw heading typed, re-set in serif; formatting chips; words scatter.
Implode to a point, ring burst, logo and tagline.
Editor window: notes typed with a live preview.
Feature cards: live preview, stays on your device, lint as you write.
Band wipe; the theme toggle is clicked and the film turns dark.
Particles to a point, ring burst, logo end card.

moments.observed: The page dims for about 0.17 s while rays converge on a point, then a bright frame and a ring expands; the accent lands at 7.55 s on the first ring frame.
moments.interpreted: A held breath before the logo, like a pre-dim before a flash.

moments.observed: The cursor clicks a sun icon; a ring ripples from it and a dark circle grows from the toggle to cover the frame by 22.03 s.
moments.interpreted: The transition is caused by the thing it demonstrates.

uncertainties: How the raw-to-serif swap is built (the 1.12 s overview frame shows a scrambled mix; no 30 fps strip of 0.8-1.9 s was made)
Whether the accents are separate effects or part of the music
